blocks.prompt: 11 (a) A rock is dropped from a cliff. One second later, another rock is dropped from the same height. What is the distance between the two rocks 2 seconds after the first rock is dropped?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh do free fall ka sawal hai: dono pathar rest se girte hain, lekin doosra ek second der se chhora jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Dono ki \(u = 0\), \(a = g = 9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\) neeche ki taraf, aur 1 second ka farq.
Find kya karna hai? Pehla pathar chhorne ke 2 second baad dono ke darmiyan faasla.
Rule kaunsa? \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}gt^2\), har pathar ke apne girne ke waqt ke saath.
Plan: pehla 2 second se gir raha hai, doosra sirf 1 second se; dono ka gira hua distance nikal kar minus karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: dono pathar ek hi jagah se rest se (\(u = 0\)) chhore gaye; \(a = g = 9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\) (neeche ko positive); doosra pehle se 1 s baad chhora gaya.
Maloom karna: pehla pathar chhorne ke \(t = 2\) s baad dono ke darmiyan faasla.
Tareeqa: \(t\) ko pehle pathar ke chhorne se ginenge. Har pathar ke liye \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}gt^2\) lagayenge, magar har ek ka apna girne ka waqt. Dono ek hi vertical line par hain, is liye faasla = dono ke gire hue distances ka farq. Hum maan rahe hain ke cliff itni oonchi hai ke abhi koi pathar zameen par nahi pohncha.

Har pathar ka gira hua distance
\[x_1 = \dfrac{1}{2}(9.8)t^2 = 4.9t^2\]
\[x_2 = 4.9(t - 1)^2,\quad t \ge 1\]
Kyun: Pehla pathar poore \(t\) second se gir raha hai. Doosra ek second baad chala, is liye woh sirf \(t - 1\) second se gir raha hai. Isi liye us ke formula mein \(t\) ki jagah \(t - 1\) aaya.
Dhyan dein: Dono ke liye ek hi \(t\) rakh dena aam ghalti hai; phir faasla hamesha zero aayega, jo ghalat hai.

t = 2 rakhein
\[x_1 = 4.9(2)^2 = 19.6\ \text{m}\]
\[x_2 = 4.9(1)^2 = 4.9\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: \(t = 2\) par pehla pathar 2 s se aur doosra 1 s se gir raha hai.

Dono ke darmiyan faasla
\[x_1 - x_2 = 19.6 - 4.9\]
\[= 14.7\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Dono ek hi point ke neeche ek hi seedhi line par hain; jo zyada gira woh neeche hai, aur faasla dono ke gire hue distances ka farq hai.

Tasdeeq
\[t = 1:\ \text{gap} = 4.9\ \text{m}\]
\[\text{gap} = 4.9 + 9.8(1) = 14.7\ \text{m}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t = 1\) par pehla pathar 4.9 m gir chuka hai aur us ki raftaar 9.8 m/s hai, jabke doosra abhi chala hai. Is ke baad dono par barabar gravity hai, is liye pehla hamesha 9.8 m/s tez rehta hai aur agle ek second mein faasla 9.8 m aur barh jata hai. Wohi 14.7 m aaya.

blocks.prompt: 11 (b) A rock is dropped from a cliff. One second later, another rock is dropped from the same height. At what time will the distance between them be 14.7 m?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (a) ka ulta sawal hai: ab faasla diya hai aur waqt poocha hai.
Diya kya hai? Faasla \(= 14.7\) m, aur part (a) wale formulas.
Find kya karna hai? Pehla pathar chhorne ke kitne second baad faasla 14.7 m hoga.
Rule kaunsa? Faasle ko \(t\) ka formula bana kar equation solve karna.
Plan: \(x_1 - x_2\) ko simplify karein, 14.7 ke barabar rakhein aur \(t\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) se \(x_1 = 4.9t^2\) aur \(x_2 = 4.9(t - 1)^2\) (\(t\) pehle pathar se gina gaya); faasla \(d = 14.7\) m.
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\).
Tareeqa: \(d = x_1 - x_2\) banayenge, usay simplify karenge, phir \(d = 14.7\) rakh kar solve karenge.

Faasla t ke formula mein
\[d = 4.9t^2 - 4.9(t - 1)^2\]
\[= 4.9[t^2 - (t^2 - 2t + 1)]\]
\[= 4.9(2t - 1)\]
Kyun: \(4.9\) common nikala aur \((t - 1)^2 = t^2 - 2t + 1\) khola. Bracket ke aage minus hai, is liye har term ka sign badla; \(t^2\) cancel ho gaya. Matlab faasla waqt ke saath ek seedhi line ki tarah barhta hai.
Dhyan dein: Bracket kholte waqt \(-(-2t) = +2t\) aur \(-(+1) = -1\) banta hai; yahan sign ki ghalti bohat hoti hai.

t kam az kam 1 hona chahiye
\[0 \le t < 1:\ d = 4.9t^2 < 4.9\]
Kyun: Pehle second mein doosra pathar abhi upar hi hai, to faasla sirf pehle pathar ka gira hua distance hai, jo 4.9 m se kam hai. 14.7 m wahan mumkin nahi, is liye jawab \(t \ge 1\) mein hi hoga aur upar wala formula theek hai.

Solve karein
\[4.9(2t - 1) = 14.7\]
\[2t - 1 = 3\]
\[t = 2\ \text{s}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 4.9 se divide kiya, kyunke \(14.7 = 3 \times 4.9\). Phir 1 jama kar ke 2 se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[x_1 - x_2 = 19.6 - 4.9 = 14.7\ \text{m}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul part (a) ka jawab hai: \(t = 2\) s par faasla 14.7 m tha. Do alag raston se ek hi natija aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Pehla pathar chhorne ke \(t = 2\) s baad (yani doosra pathar chhorne ke 1 s baad).
